description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meerigama Village, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha  District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and land title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
